title: Alert thresholds (alert.thresholds/v1)
description: Versioned default or fully resolved alert thresholds. Collectors warn when a condition is met. Destinations in v1 are the Orbit dashboard and a board note only. Operators override individual keys with an alert.thresholds.override/v1 document; omitted keys keep these defaults. at_bee_cap is warn-only in v1. Daily model spend above 10 USD supersedes a 5 USD/day draft.

destinations.description: v1 destinations are the Orbit dashboard and a board note. No chat and no Discord.

deepseek_balance_below_usd.description: Warn when a DeepSeek balance is below this amount in US dollars.

go_allowance_pct_used.description: Warn when an OpenCode Go key has used this percent of its monthly allowance.

go_429_streak.description: Warn after this many OpenCode Go HTTP 429 errors in a row.

stuck_bee_no_progress_s.description: Warn when a bee has been stuck with no progress for this many seconds (default 1800, 30 minutes).

blocker_age_s.description: Warn when a board blocker has been open longer than this many seconds (default 14400, 4 hours).

disk_free_pct.description: Warn when free disk space is below this percent.

bees_in_flight_warn_at.description: Warn when the number of bees in flight reaches this value. The default is the shared cap of 12.

daily_model_spend_above_usd.description: Warn when daily model spend is above this amount in US dollars. The default is 10, which supersedes a 5 USD/day draft.

at_bee_cap.description: At the shared bee cap, warn only. Pausing non-priority bees is not a v1 action and needs a later approval.
